thread:
jordan: deploy-bot stopped the rollout. preflight reports KMS key mismatch for SecureString params between staging and prod. pause until resolved. :lock:
deploy-bot: preflight check failure: secret_encryption_kms_key_id parity. See snippet.
infra-bot: preflight log:
```
checking secret metadata for service=inference-api
staging.kms_key_id = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-111111111111
prod.kms_key_id    = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222222:key/bbbbbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeee-222222222222
mismatch -> fail
```
anya: oh, we onboarded staging into the dev account last sprint, looks like it used the dev key. prod uses the org-managed key.
sam: that will cause decryption failures if any part of the rollout reads the param with prod identity. we need parity.
release-coordinator: what's the lowest-risk remediation for the 2hr change window? migrate staging secrets to use the prod KMS key, or change the deploy flow to accept multiple key ids?
sre-ops: changing deploy code is more invasive and risks regressions. migrating the params is straightforward but we must ensure key policies allow re-encrypt. also need audit and retention policy.
jordan: can we do a blind copy: decrypt with staging key and put-parameter with --key-id equal to prod key? Any cross-account restrictions?
sre-ops: cross-account might block if policies don't allow the prod key to be used in staging account. but both envs are in same org, different accounts. I can check policies quickly.
infra-bot: infra check: prod KMS alias alias/redwood-prod has policy restricting use to prod-account role only. current policy blocks writes from staging.
anya: then we need a temporary patch: create a compatible key in staging with the same alias and key policy, or add staging principal to prod key policy. adding staging principal to prod key policy has security review overhead. creating a new staging key and updating params to use it keeps blast radius smaller.
sam: but then parity still fails. deploy-bot preflight compares KMS arn values. we could instead update preflight to detect equivalent aliases (alias/redwood-prod == alias/redwood-prod-copy) but that is brittle.
release-coordinator: for this release, we want parity in values, not just equivalence. proposal: create a staging KMS key that replicates prod key id format via alias and then update preflight to accept configured mapping (short-term). long-term: INFRA-1301 to consolidate keys.
sre-ops: action plan: 1) create a new staging key with alias alias/redwood-prod (namespaces are per-account so allowed) 2) re-encrypt staging SecureString params to use that key 3) rerun preflight -> should pass 4) proceed with release pinned to image sha. I'll prepare the audit entry and rollback steps.
jordan: runbook commands for re-encrypt (dry-run):
```
# list params
aws ssm describe-parameters --filters Key=description,Values="inference-api" --query 'Parameters[].Name' --output text
# for each param: decrypt then put with new key
aws ssm get-parameter --name /redwood/inference/redis --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text | \aws ssm put-parameter --name /redwood/inference/redis --value - --type SecureString --key-id alias/redwood-prod --overwrite
```
anya: please don't overwrite in-place without dry-run. we should write to a temp name and verify consumption in canary. e.g. write to /redwood/inference/redis.enc-test then swap alias in config via feature-flag for canary only.
sam: that adds config change surface. given timebox, I suggest write to temp names and update the canary's env override to read temp names. no code change to shim.
sre-ops: agreed. plan: create temp params with new key, update canary pod override to map env REDIS_PARAM -> /redwood/inference/redis.enc-test, run canary, then move final params into place after verification. audit ID AUD-20260321-02.
deploy-bot: release v2026.04 paused by policy: env-parity-secret-encryption. Rollout window 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC.
release-coordinator: pin image to ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api@sha256:def456... no other changes. canary-only override will be applied via rollout config.
jordan: doing dry-run now, found 4 SecureString params referencing staging key. posting list in DM.
anya: i'll prepare the canary env override and coordinate with CI to trigger a targeted canary deployment.
sre-ops: created staging key alias/redwood-prod in account-staging (key id = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/cccccccc-dddd-eeee-ffff-333333333333). created temp params, audit logged AUD-20260321-02.
jordan: applied canary env override, canary started. metrics coming in.
infra-bot: canary health: 2m in, p50 +3ms, error rate 0.1% (baseline 0.1). no secret-related errors in logs.
sre-ops: monitoring ok. after 15m stable we'll promote. rollback criteria: any decrypt errors in logs or >1% 5xx for 5m -> immediate rollback to previous image and param bindings.
release-coordinator: promote to gradual rollout at +20m. remember to schedule INFRA-1301 for centralizing key use and update preflight to use mapping (temporary) -> ticket created INFRA-1299 to update preflight mapping and INFRA-1301 for consolidation.
jordan: after promotion, will schedule cleanup: remove temp params and consider rotating keys in 48h. will not delete old staging key until cleanup.
sam: thanks. posting summary to release notes draft: "Release v2026.04: resolved staging/prod KMS mismatch by creating temporary staging alias and re-encrypting SecureString params; pinned image def456; monitoring hooks and audit AUD-20260321-02; follow-ups INFRA-1299, INFRA-1301."
release-coordinator: closing threads once prod stable. :white_check_mark:
